lead.headline: McMillan's 45 buried it; Monangai's thumb decides Tuesday
lead.deck: You trail 97.6 to 153.6 with only Kamara left. Nothing to set today. The claim that matters goes in tomorrow, once the thumb result is known.
lead.body: The week is lost and it was lost on the other side. Tetairoa McMillan caught 14 passes for 192 yards and two touchdowns on Sunday night, 45.2 points, in the game Jalen Coker sat out with his quad. Kyren Williams added 36.7. Aye-Aye finished on 153.56, and you are on 97.62 with Alvin Kamara to play. Your own bench held 46 points from two backs, Kyle Monangai's 28.0 and Ollie Gordon's 18.0, behind Bhayshul Tuten's 11.1; the projection chose Tuten, no brief overrode it, and even the perfect lineup would have lost by twenty. What carries into next week is the injury list. Monangai hurt his thumb at the end of a 30-carry game and was being examined today. Justin Jefferson's coach said this morning that he has no projection for Week 5, with Minnesota's bye the week after. Terry McLaurin pushed to play in London and didn't. Coker can't play before 18 October. Nobody who started for you was hurt. Garrett Wilson's 5.7 came in a game the Jets held the ball for 17 minutes. Tomorrow's brief is the last before waivers process at 01:00 on Wednesday, and whether there is a claim depends on a thumb.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to set today
doFirst.deck: Kamara is in the flex and everyone else has played.
doFirst.note: Tuesday's brief is the last before claims process at 01:00 Wednesday. It needs Monangai's thumb result and any word on Jefferson before it can name a drop for Metcalf.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to do this Monday: Kamara is where the projection puts him and the result is settled. The claim, if there is one, is Tuesday's.

roster.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup. It left Monangai's 28.0 and Gordon's 18.0 on the bench; both were the projection's calls, not overrides.

wire.headline: Metcalf is still the claim, and there is still no drop
wire.deck: Claims process Wednesday at 01:00. The screen was researched this morning: no claims, two watches (Bigsby, Dohnte Meyers), sixteen passes.

That report is from 1 Oct, so ESPN will have it when it sets Week 5. What would change it: Dowdle practising in full on Wednesday.

4569618.deck: Final: 5.7. Healthy; the Jets threw 15 times.
4569618.reason: Four targets in a game Chicago held the ball for 42:45
4569618.availability: PLAYED — healthy, no injury reported (RotoWire; NBC Sports, 4 Oct). Nothing new Monday morning
4569618.role: 3 catches on 4 targets for 27: 5.7 (archive), after 7, 7, 13 targets. Chicago held the ball for 42:45 and Geno Smith threw 15 passes (Yahoo/Last Word on Sports, 4 Oct)
4569618.competition: Adonai Mitchell (finger), Mason Taylor and Breece Hall (quad, 'week-to-week' per Rapoport via PFN) were all inactive; no Week 5 word on any of them. Sadiq caught none of 4 targets; Isaiah Williams had 2 catches for 73 with a 58-yard touchdown (NewYorkJets.com)

Aaron Glenn: 'We'll have to look at the tape to see why... we have to find a way to get them the ball.' Wilson: 'I want more on my plate, for sure.' VACATED answered: Mitchell's absence was priced at 16.5 and the volume never came. No Monday statement from the Jets found
4569618.logic: Projected 16.5, scored 5.7; the projection's call lost by 10.8. The cause is game script, not role: 15 pass attempts, 17 minutes of possession, and his coach saying they must get him the ball. One week of results never overrides the projection. Week 5 is Cleveland at home, a defence several columns are streaming against the Jets. What would change it: a quarterback change, or a second week under six targets with Smith healthy.

4429205.logic: Projected 14.8, scored 9.1; the projection's call lost by 5.7 and still beat the alternative, Coker, who was inactive. Jefferson's absence was priced before kickoff. The volume was there for Minnesota, 37 attempts, and went elsewhere. What would change it: Jefferson returning on Wednesday's report, which makes him the second receiver again.

What would change it: Nabers' shoulder is the only moving part, and it would add targets, not take them.

4608686.deck: Final: 28.0 on the bench. Thumb result pending.
4608686.reason: 30 carries after Swift's fumble; thumb examined today
4608686.availability: QUESTIONABLE — thumb. Ben Johnson disclosed it after the game; Monangai was to have it checked on Monday and 'didn't recall how it happened' (NBC Sports/PFT; Bears Wire, 4 Oct). No diagnosis by 07:30. The first injury report is Wednesday
4608686.role: 30 carries for 146 and two touchdowns, 1 catch for 4: 28.0 (archive), after exactly 10 carries in each of the first three games. Johnson: 'When you see a guy running like that, as a play caller you just want to keep feeding him'
4608686.competition: D'Andre Swift: 15 carries for 58, lost a fumble in the third quarter and didn't play on offence again. Asked if he was benched or hurt, Johnson said 'No, nothing like that.' Yahoo (5 Oct) and Sportsmockery call it a benching; Heavy says Johnson indicated Swift remains the starter. Season rushing: Monangai 324, Swift 311 (ChiCitySports)
4608686.passer: Tyson Bagent, 25 of 34 for 268. Caleb Williams has a Grade 2 hamstring strain, two weeks into a three-to-four-week estimate, and didn't practise last week; Yahoo/SI calls him unlikely for Green Bay
4608686.checked: NBC Sports/PFT, Windy City Gridiron, Bears Wire, SI, RotoWire, Heavy, 4–5 Oct. OWN_QUESTIONABLE answered: it is the thumb, from Sunday, with no result yet. Outlets disagree on whether Swift was benched; I take the coach's words and call it unknown

vsProjection.text: Thirty carries and a thumb injury both happened after the Week 4 number was set; believe neither until Wednesday's report and the Week 5 projection.

4608686.logic: Projected 8.3 against Tuten's 12.7 and Kamara's 10.6, so the projection benched him and he scored 28.0. Ten carries a game became thirty after Swift fumbled; the coach denies a benching. That is one game. The thumb has no diagnosis. What would change it: a clean result today plus Johnson naming a split makes him next week's flex question, and ESPN's Week 5 number answers it.

cannotSee.body: None existed at 07:30. Monangai's thumb was being examined today; there is no diagnosis. Tuesday's brief should have it, and it decides whether there is a claim at all.

cannotSee.body: O'Connell gives no projection for Jefferson. 'Could sit until after the bye' is a headline I couldn't read past. McLaurin 'pushed to play' is a coach's phrase, not a practice report. Both are first tested on Wednesday, after claims process.

cannotSee.label: Week 5 projections
